note: Qualitative scenario library. grade: read = source text read; search-summary = search-engine summary only; generic = standard hazard vocabulary with no specific source; none = no source read, fields left blank. Prompts are prompts, not requirements.

entries.title: Biogas and compressed-biogas (CBG) plant
hazards: hydrogen sulphide toxicity (denser than air, pools in low areas)
air ingress creating an explosive atmosphere
initiating_events: pressure build-up in digester or gas containment
barriers: sealing against air entry to digester and gasholder
division into fire sectors (bioreactor and gasholder, consumption, compressor)
hazid_prompts: What can introduce air into the digester or gasholder, and what keeps the mixture outside the flammable range?
Where does H2S collect if the gas escapes, and who can enter that space?
What is the largest flammable inventory between upgrading and the compressor, and what isolates it?
How are the fire sectors separated and what is the escalation path between them?
gaps: No biogas-specific frequencies or digester model
Pressurised biomethane storage and compression barely covered by the sources found
Figures in the sources not verified from full text

sources.title: Scarponi et al., biogas plant risk (CET 43)
Trento fault-tree study, fire in the digester
Baker Engineering, safe design of RNG facilities

entries.title: Combustible dust explosion and venting
hazards: deflagration of dust clouds in vessels, silos and filters
initiating_events: dust cloud formation with an ignition source
hazid_prompts: Which equipment can hold a dust cloud, and which ignition sources are credible there?
What happens to the explosion path if the vent discharges into an occupied area?
gaps: Vent-area sizing (NFPA 68, EN 14491) not implemented: standards paywalled and not read
NFPA 660 (2025) merges six legacy dust codes; mapping not done

sources.title: Explosion panel sizing guide (inputs Kst, Pmax, Pred, Pstat, L/D)
Archon Blast (commercial, based on NFPA 68 2018)

entries.title: Ammonia fuel bunkering release
barriers: emergency plans benchmarked to AEGL-3 scenarios
hazid_prompts: What is the largest release between the two emergency shutdown points, and how fast do they close?
How does ambient temperature change the safety zone (winter zones were larger in one study)?
gaps: Aerosol and rainout are inputs, not predicted
dense_gas covers only low target concentrations and the EPA text says Britter-McQuaid is less justified for ammonia
Figures not verified from full text

sources.title: MDPI Energies 2025, ammonia truck bunkering probit
PNNL, QRA during truck-to-ship ammonia bunkering
UK P&I Club, ship-to-ship ammonia transfer trial

entries.title: Sustainable aviation fuel (HEFA and co-processing) plant
hazards: larger exotherms and water formation at higher renewable feed ratios
carbon monoxide, nitrogen and carbon dioxide hazards on biomass routes
initiating_events: loss of quench or hydrogen supply
new equipment added to older plant with older detection standards
barriers: current fire and gas detection standards for new equipment
gas detection for CO on biomass routes
hazid_prompts: How does a higher renewable feed ratio change the reactor exotherm margin against the trip and relief basis?
Does the existing detection and zoning cover the new hydrogen and CO sources?
gaps: No incident reports found
Alcohol-to-jet and ethanol-plant hazards not covered by the sources found
Vendor and trade material only

sources.title: BriSafe, putting the safety in SAF
Topsoe Q and A on co-processing

entries.title: Battery energy storage thermal runaway and enclosure explosion
hazards: flammable vent gas (hydrogen) in an enclosure
initiating_events: gas accumulation in a container or battery room
barriers: explosion control required by NFPA 855 for containers of about small ISO size or larger
NFPA 69 concentration limit via mechanical purge ventilation
UL 9540A test data as the source term
hazid_prompts: What is the vent-gas rate and composition from the test data, and where does it accumulate?
What ventilation rate keeps the room below the chosen fraction of the lower flammable limit?
gaps: Vent-gas source term must come from test data (not coded)
Enclosure explosion pressure and vent sizing not implemented
Limit fraction is an input; the 25 percent figure is secondary-source only

sources.title: Jensen Hughes, BESS explosion prevention with CFD
WVU dissertation on battery enclosure explosions

entries.title: Dense-phase CO2 pipeline rupture
hazards: solids formation near a dense release
hazid_prompts: Does the decompression wave outrun the crack at the operating pressure and impurity content?
gaps: Existing gas-pipeline fracture-control methods do not apply to dense-phase CO2
Needs a real-fluid equation of state; not implemented
Hazard distances not covered by the sources found

sources.title: UCL, brittle fracture in CO2 pipelines
Surrey pipeline safety group

entries.title: LNG rollover and rapid phase transition
hazards: sudden mixing of stratified layers releasing boil-off vapour
barriers: tank relief capacity sized for rollover
hazid_prompts: Can the relief system pass the rollover vapour rate if stratification is not managed?
gaps: No stratification or rollover model
At least 24 rollover incidents since 1960 per one review (count not verified)

sources.title: Shebeko, rollover and RPT review (Fire and Explosion Safety 2023)

entries.title: Flashing liquefied-gas release (LPG, ammonia)
initiating_events: hole, rupture or relief discharge from liquefied-gas storage
hazid_prompts: How much of the release is airborne and how much rains out, and what pool does the rainout form?
gaps: Rainout and droplet size are inputs
No two-phase jet-flame correlations
Not wired into the QRA consequence step

sources.title: Witlox and Fernandez, ATEX atmospheric expansion (Hazards 26)
HSE RR1189, QUADVENT flashing releases

entries.title: Jet fire and flame impingement on metal
hazards: flame impingement on vessels and pipes
barriers: deluge (not reliable over a whole LPG vessel surface per HSE tests)
hazid_prompts: What is the flame length and where does it touch equipment?
How long to the failure temperature and can depressuring beat it?
gaps: Vapour Chamberlain only, not validated
Fire-temperature steel properties are recalled until EN 1993-1-2 is read

sources.title: DNV JFSH theory, Jet Fire
HSE RR1187

entries.title: Dense-gas cloud dispersion
hazid_prompts: Is the release dense under the actual wind and source conditions (criterion), or passive?
gaps: Far-field fit only; no flammable-limit distances
Aerosol correction not implemented
HSE CRR 17/1988 original not read (copy blocked)

sources.title: EPA TSCREEN workbook, section 5.4 (Britter-McQuaid)

entries.title: Hydrogen release, jet flame and enclosure accumulation
initiating_events: leak or rupture from high-pressure hydrogen equipment
hazid_prompts: Where can hydrogen accumulate and is the detection placed for a buoyant gas?
gaps: HyRAM+ (GPL-3.0) is the open tool; not copied, use as an external check
DNV Miller low-luminosity model not implemented
Sandia compatibility reference not read for thresholds

sources.title: HyRAM+ (Sandia)
Sandia hydrogen compatibility technical reference

entries.title: Cryogenic spill on carbon steel
initiating_events: LNG or LN2 spill onto structure
hazid_prompts: Which structure can a spill reach, and is its steel rated for the spill temperature?
gaps: NIST fits cover 304 stainless; no carbon-steel page; nickel-steel pages unreliable
No internationally standardised brittle-fracture hazard area method

sources.title: NIST cryogenic 304 stainless page
NTNU, permanent effect of a cryogenic spill on carbon steel

entries.title: Vapour cloud explosion, multi-energy method
hazards: blast from a congested or confined flammable cloud
initiating_events: delayed ignition of a flammable cloud
hazid_prompts: Which parts of the cloud are congested enough to act as separate blast sources?
gaps: Blast curves are in the TNO Yellow Book; no open copy found
Only TNT equivalence implemented

sources.title: Chalmers, blast loads from vapour cloud explosions

entries.title: BLEVE: blast and fragments
initiating_events: fire exposure of a pressurised liquefied-gas vessel
hazid_prompts: Can the vessel survive the fire long enough for depressuring to work?
gaps: Radiation only; no blast or fragment model

entries.title: Boilover and slopover in hydrocarbon tanks
hazid_prompts: What water can reach a hot-oil layer in a tank fire?
gaps: No source read yet; hazards, events and barriers left blank rather than guessed

entries.title: Domino escalation between units
hazid_prompts: Which units are within the escalation threshold of each credible primary event?
gaps: No source read yet; escalation thresholds not coded

entries.title: Layout and separation distances
hazid_prompts: Do the inter-distances meet the governing standard for each pair of facilities?
gaps: OISD-STD-118: only unofficial copies marked for restricted circulation found, so no distances are shipped; a checker would take your distances as inputs

entries.title: Hazardous-area classification extents
hazid_prompts: What are the release grade, ventilation and extent for each source?
gaps: IEC 60079-10-1 and EI 15 paywalled; only the duration rule is coded

entries.title: Runaway reaction and two-phase relief (DIERS)
hazid_prompts: Is the relief sized for the two-phase runaway flow rather than vapour only?
gaps: Omega method coded; runaway vent-sizing methods not implemented and no open source read
